method.reachability_rule: A dependency is hardware-reachable only if selected top/import/instantiation closure references its package; vendored presence alone is not reachability.
method.source_count_rule: Counts are tracked src/main/scala files in the family scope; tests/docs/build outputs excluded.
method.nested_family_policy: Parent cache families intentionally include child files; child counts are non-additive closure views. Use source_paths, not summed family counts, to derive unique source coverage.
method.conditional_branch_policy: Both CHI and TileLink branches are inventoried because configuration selects one at elaboration; a branch is not promoted to a product Build until its selected-top evidence is available.

non_target_roots.reason: debug scripts and support files; include only if selected hardware closure reaches them
generator/tool support, not a Python hardware family by default
workloads and test inputs, not hardware rewrite targets
